objective: mean_{k=1..30} exp(-(F(p(T*k/30))-1.2)/.6); continuous target integral_0^1 exp(-(d_mesh(p(T*u))-1.2)/.6) du

convergence_tolerances.policy: all rows retained, including unconverged; finite last-level results are numerical references, not exact continuous integrals

map_builder.limits: Controlled same-OBJ raw box-face+ground sampling, float32 .1m-max spacing; not original dataset/generator/PCL VoxelGrid. Interior is not filled. Original floor-index, double EDT, no half-cell correction preserved.

limits: Same-OBJ controlled surface PLY, not original absent dataset; reference original shell EDT/crop/clamp preserved. Double common-chain accuracy and literal float32 forward distinct. Finite quadrature convergence is not a continuous collision guarantee. No trajectory optimizer or formal training API added.

fixtures.selection: fixed geometry-selected stress fixtures; not random population statistics
fixtures.candidate_rule: 5 terminal y offsets x 3 terminal z offsets; small p/v/a variations
fixtures.classification: side, top and ground are intended anchors; free/near/penetrating labels are not assumed
fixtures.hull_domain_check: all six boundary-derived Bernstein control points lie inside logical bounds

actual_float32_shared_chain.scope: float32 common fit/Horner/30-point mean; mesh evaluated at the same represented positions, with its first branch derivative

independent_checks.original_builder_parity: bitwise; integrated replay EDT and occupancy files equal to the parity-checked first run
